method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: rpc_get_block
tools.title: Get Block
tools.description: [Read-only] Retrieve complete block with all transactions. For header only: rpc_get_header.

tools.name: rpc_get_block_by_number
tools.title: Get Block by Number
tools.description: [Read-only] Retrieve complete block by number. For header only: rpc_get_header_by_number.

tools.name: rpc_get_header
tools.title: Get Header
tools.description: [Read-only] Retrieve block header without transactions. For full block: rpc_get_block.

tools.name: rpc_get_header_by_number
tools.title: Get Header by Number
tools.description: [Read-only] Retrieve block header by number. For full block: rpc_get_block_by_number.

tools.name: rpc_get_transaction
tools.title: Get Transaction
tools.description: [Read-only] Retrieve transaction data and status by hash. For pending txs: rpc_get_pool_tx_detail.

tools.name: rpc_get_block_hash
tools.title: Get Block Hash
tools.description: [Read-only] Convert block number to hash. For full block data: rpc_get_block_by_number.

tools.name: rpc_get_tip_header
tools.title: Get Tip Header
tools.description: [Read-only] Get latest block header from chain tip. For block number only: rpc_get_tip_block_number.

tools.name: rpc_get_tip_block_number
tools.title: Get Tip Block Number
tools.description: [Read-only] Get current chain height. For full header: rpc_get_tip_header.

tools.name: rpc_get_current_epoch
tools.title: Get Current Epoch
tools.description: [Read-only] Get current epoch number, start block, and length. For historical: rpc_get_epoch_by_number.

tools.name: rpc_get_epoch_by_number
tools.title: Get Epoch by Number
tools.description: [Read-only] Get historical epoch details. For current epoch: rpc_get_current_epoch.

tools.name: rpc_get_live_cell
tools.title: Get Live Cell
tools.description: [Read-only] Get single cell by outpoint. For bulk queries: rpc_search_cells.

tools.name: rpc_get_fork_block
tools.title: Get Fork Block
tools.description: [Read-only] Get orphaned block from chain reorganization. For canonical blocks: rpc_get_block.

verbosity.description: Result format: 0 (hex string) or 2 (JSON object, default)

tools.name: rpc_get_indexer_tip
tools.title: Get Indexer Tip
tools.description: [Read-only] Get indexer sync status. Check before using rpc_search_cells or rpc_search_transactions.

tools.name: rpc_search_cells
tools.title: Search Cells
tools.description: [Read-only] Search cells by script criteria with full filter control. For total capacity: rpc_get_cells_capacity.

tools.name: rpc_search_transactions
tools.title: Search Transactions
tools.description: [Read-only] Search transaction history by script. For single tx: rpc_get_transaction.

tools.name: rpc_get_cells_capacity
tools.title: Get Cells Capacity
tools.description: [Read-only] Get total capacity of matching cells. For cell details: rpc_search_cells.

tools.name: rpc_submit_transaction
tools.title: Submit Transaction
tools.description: [Modifies state] Submit transaction to network for inclusion. Validate first with rpc_test_transaction.

tools.name: rpc_test_transaction
tools.title: Test Transaction
tools.description: [Read-only] Dry-run transaction validation without broadcasting. Use before rpc_submit_transaction.

tools.name: rpc_get_node_info
tools.title: Get Node Info
tools.description: [Read-only] Get node version, protocols, and addresses. For sync status: rpc_get_sync_state.

tools.name: rpc_get_sync_state
tools.title: Get Sync State
tools.description: [Read-only] Get chain sync progress and IBD status. For node info: rpc_get_node_info.

tools.name: rpc_get_peers
tools.title: Get Peers
tools.description: [Read-only] Get connected peer addresses and protocols. For node status: rpc_get_node_info.

tools.name: rpc_get_pool_info
tools.title: Get Pool Info
tools.description: [Read-only] Get mempool size, limits, and fee statistics. For pending txs: rpc_get_pool_transactions.

tools.name: rpc_get_pool_ready
tools.title: Get Pool Ready
tools.description: [Read-only] Check if mempool is ready. Call before rpc_submit_transaction.

tools.name: rpc_get_pool_transactions
tools.title: Get Pool Transactions
tools.description: [Read-only] List all pending transaction hashes. For tx details: rpc_get_pool_tx_detail.

verbose.description: True for detailed JSON, false for array of tx IDs

tools.name: rpc_get_pool_tx_detail
tools.title: Get Pool TX Detail
tools.description: [Read-only] Get pending transaction details including fee and ancestors. For committed: rpc_get_transaction.

tools.name: rpc_get_blockchain_info
tools.title: Get Blockchain Info
tools.description: [Read-only] Get chain type (mainnet/testnet), difficulty, and alerts. For consensus: rpc_get_consensus.

tools.name: rpc_get_consensus
tools.title: Get Consensus
tools.description: [Read-only] Get consensus rules, block intervals, and reward parameters. For forks: rpc_get_deployments.

tools.name: rpc_get_deployments
tools.title: Get Deployments
tools.description: [Read-only] Get soft fork activation status and thresholds. For consensus params: rpc_get_consensus.

tools.name: rpc_estimate_cycles
tools.title: Estimate Cycles
tools.description: [Read-only] Estimate script execution cycles for fee calculation. For fee rate: rpc_estimate_fee_rate.

tools.name: rpc_estimate_fee_rate
tools.title: Estimate Fee Rate
tools.description: [Read-only] Estimate fee rate in shannons/KB from recent blocks. For cycles: rpc_estimate_cycles.

tools.name: rpc_calculate_dao_withdraw
tools.title: Calculate DAO Withdraw
tools.description: [Read-only] Calculate DAO withdrawal amount with accumulated interest. For block economics: rpc_get_block_economics.

kind.description: Block hash (string) or out_point of phase 1 tx

out_point.description: Reference to the DAO deposit cell

tools.name: rpc_get_block_economics
tools.title: Get Block Economics
tools.description: [Read-only] Get block issuance, miner rewards, and fee breakdown. For DAO: rpc_calculate_dao_withdraw.

tools.name: rpc_get_block_median_time
tools.title: Get Block Median Time
tools.description: [Read-only] Get median time of 37 blocks for time-lock validation. For block header: rpc_get_header.

block_hash.description: Block hash indicating highest block in sequence

tools.name: rpc_get_block_filter
tools.title: Get Block Filter
tools.description: [Read-only] Get BIP-157 block filter for light client SPV. For tx proof: rpc_get_transaction_proof.

block_hash.description: Block hash to get filter for

tools.name: rpc_get_transaction_proof
tools.title: Get Transaction Proof
tools.description: [Read-only] Generate Merkle proof for tx inclusion. Verify with rpc_verify_transaction_proof.

tx_hashes.description: Transaction hashes (must be in same block)

tools.name: rpc_verify_transaction_proof
tools.title: Verify Transaction Proof
tools.description: [Read-only] Verify Merkle proof from rpc_get_transaction_proof. Returns verified tx hashes.

tools.name: dev_deploy_cell_data
tools.title: Deploy Cell Data
tools.description: [Modifies state] Deploy a cell with hex-encoded data (max 1KB). Creates on-chain data cell using configured private key.

data.description: Hex-encoded data to deploy in the cell (without 0x prefix). Maximum 1KB after decoding.

tools.name: dev_get_address_balance
tools.title: Get Address Balance
tools.description: [Read-only] Get address balance breakdown (total/free/occupied). For richer address info: rpc_search_cells.

address.description: Optional CKB address to check balance for. If omitted, checks the default address from private key.

tools.name: dev_get_chain_type
tools.title: Get Chain Type
tools.description: [Read-only] Get connected CKB node chain type (mainnet/testnet/devnet). Value is fixed for a given node.

tools.name: dev_get_genesis_hash
tools.title: Get Genesis Hash
tools.description: [Read-only] Get the genesis block hash of the connected CKB chain. Value is immutable.

tools.name: dev_generate_lock_info
tools.title: Generate Lock Info
tools.description: [Read-only] Pure computation: derive pubkey, lock arg, lock script, lock hash, and addresses from private key.

private_key.description: Private key in hex format (with or without 0x prefix). Required parameter.

tools.name: dev_get_lock_info_from_address
tools.title: Get Lock Info from Address
tools.description: [Read-only] Pure computation: extract lock script, lock hash, and lock arg from a CKB address.

tools.name: dev_request_testnet_funds
tools.title: Request Testnet Funds
tools.description: [External call] Request CKB testnet funds from the faucet service. Only works on testnet.

address.description: Optional CKB testnet address to receive funds. If omitted, uses the default address from private key.

tools.name: dev_get_default_account_info
tools.title: Get Default Account Info
tools.description: [Read-only] Get server's default account: address, lock script, and capacity breakdown (total/free/occupied).

tools.name: ckb_query_address
tools.title: Query Address
tools.description: [Read-only] Get complete address state: balance breakdown, recent cells, lock info. Combines search_cells + get_cells_capacity.

address.description: CKB address to query. If omitted, uses the default address from private key.

cell_limit.description: Maximum number of cells to return

tools.name: ckb_query_chain_status
tools.title: Query Chain Status
tools.description: [Read-only] Get chain health snapshot: tip block, sync state, indexer status, mempool info. Single call replaces 4 RPC queries.

tools.name: ckb_query_transaction
tools.title: Query Transaction
tools.description: [Read-only] Get transaction with resolved input cells. Shows what was consumed, not just outpoints.

cell.description: Resolved cell data or null if consumed

tools.name: ckb_validate_transaction
tools.title: Validate Transaction
tools.description: [Read-only] Complete pre-submission validation: dry-run, cycle estimation, fee rate check.

tools.name: ckb_query_script_cells
tools.title: Query Script Cells
tools.description: [Read-only] Find cells by lock or type script with simplified parameters.

args.description: Script args (0x-prefixed hex). Optional prefix matching supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of cells to return

script_type.description: Whether to search by lock script or type script

search_key.description: The search key used for query

total_capacity.description: Total capacity of all matching cells

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search Tools
tools.description: Search available MCP tools by keyword. Returns matching tools with names and descriptions. Use this to discover relevant tools before calling them.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10, max: 50.

query.description: Search keyword(s) to match against tool names and descriptions.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.title: Search Resources
tools.description: Search available documentation resources by keyword. Returns matching resources with URIs and descriptions. Use this to find relevant CKB development documentation.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10, max: 50.

query.description: Search keyword(s) to match against resource names and descriptions.
